summary: In Arnold, Maryland, Pines on the Severn Living Shoreline is an implementation initiative. The documented approach is to construct a 400-foot living shoreline rather than replacing failing bulkheads with hard shoreline reinforcement. Shoreline erosion, flooding, drainage, and runoff pressures affected the community's shared Severn River waterfront. The original source reports increased usable waterfront acreage, improved aesthetics and wildlife habitat, and greater resident awareness of water-quality issues.
title: Pines on the Severn Living Shoreline
transferability: Useful as an external comparator for community shoreline planning, grant-supported implementation, and nature-based erosion control.
